Lab Safety Contract Tracker

See at a glance who has turned in a signed lab safety contract — and who still can't do labs yet.

Paste your class list, one name per line. Saving the roster keeps existing contract records, even for names you remove.

Required documents

Each document gets its own signed/unsigned toggle per student. Most classes only need one — add more (e.g. “Chemical Handling” alongside “Lab Safety Contract”) if your class requires several signed forms. The form text prints on the blank copy — leave it empty to print just a title and signature lines. If a document has a fee, set it and a paid/unpaid toggle appears for that document per student — leave the fee blank for documents that don’t collect money. Each printed copy also carries a small code identifying which student it belongs to, for “Scan returned forms” below.

Scan returned forms

Point a camera at the returned papers, one at a time — each scan reads that student’s printed code and checks them off, no typing or hunting through the list. Works from “Print blank forms” copies only, since that’s what stamps the code on.
